question: Whom should one feed daily and with what kind of food offerings?
premises: Twelve twice-born men are specified as recipients.
The feeding is to be done daily.
The food should be accompanied by sweet items.
inference: One should daily feed twelve twice-born men with food accompanied by sweets.
uncertainties: The exact number implied by bhānu+saṅkhyān is traditionally twelve but not explicit in the verse.
plain_english: One should daily feed twelve twice-born men with foods accompanied by sweets.
